rollups.text: Employment and professional experience: Wahoo Fitness, Minneapolis/remote, since October 2021; QA Test Engineer, November 2021–November 2022; QA Automation Test Engineer, November 2022 onward. Work includes bike-computer test automation, test planning and execution, CI analysis, defect reporting, and expanding test coverage. Skills include Python, pytest, pytest-bdd, Jira, Zephyr Scale, Jenkins, BDD, mobile-app testing, and embedded-device testing.

Travel plans and interests: planned a solo San Antonio trip for September 2023, considering the Alamo, River Walk, Pearl District and Pearl Farmers Market, and San Antonio Missions National Historical Park. Planned a Hawaii family vacation and asked about helicopter tours, snorkeling, Pearl Harbor and Dole Plantation on 2023-08-25; by 2023-11-30, said they had returned from a family vacation in Hawaii. Considered a short getaway to Greenville, South Carolina, on 2023-10-05, including downtown, the Reedy River area, the Swamp Rabbit Trail and Falls Park. Considered Cambodia and Vietnam on 2023-11-30, including Siem Reap temples and Ho Chi Minh City. Planned a Las Vegas bachelor-party trip for June 2024. Past travel mentioned includes an enjoyable four-day Chicago trip in February 2023 and an exhilarating helicopter tour over islands on a previous trip.

Yoga and wellbeing practices: the user said yoga twice a week helped them relax and focus (date unspecified); on 2023-08-11 said it helped them feel grounded and centered, especially on anxious days; in a later work-planning discussion said they attend yoga three times a week and that it clears their head and improves focus. The user also uses meditation to set daily intentions and goals and has a therapist they find helpful.

Home furnishings and decorating: assembled a bookshelf over the 2023-09-16–2023-09-17 weekend; considered a minimalist oak-toned console table behind the couch, decorated with framed photos and fresh flowers, on 2023-09-22. In November 2023, wanted a traditional wooden TV stand with storage, a natural oak or walnut finish, ornate details such as carved legs or raised-panel doors, crown molding, and brass or bronze hardware to complement a classic coffee table. Also considered four modern minimalist dining chairs with upholstered seats, possibly light gray textured upholstery, for a light, airy dining room.

Creative and art interests: the user inherited 15 art books from an aunt who was an art historian and is interested in Impressionism, Cubism, and Abstract Expressionism. As of 2023-12-12, the user attended Saturday art classes at a local studio, working on a watercolor still life; watercolor was new and unpredictable compared with oil painting. The user had previously made an oil painting titled “Sunset Over the Ocean,” purchased from a local artist and displayed in the living room. The user enjoys art as a way to express emotions and evoke moods.

Video games and gaming: the user plays Rocket League with friends, usually casual or competitive 3v3, and was practicing aerials and aiming for Platinum in December 2023; they were also trying Hoops and adjusting to its gravity and ball physics. They had been playing Overwatch frequently, particularly as Baptiste, and working to master his healing abilities. They had played World of Warcraft previously but said they no longer had time for it. The user pre-ordered Cyberpunk 2077 during the week before 2023-12-08 and was eager to play. Their PC has an Intel Core i7-9700K, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080, 16 GB DDR4 3200 MHz RAM, and Windows 10.

Books, authors, and literary events: on 2023-12-08, the user attended a literary festival in downtown Chicago and went to back-to-back readings by favorite authors Celeste Ng and Gabrielle Zevin. The user had recently been reading literary fiction, was interested in Liane Moriarty’s “Big Little Lies,” enjoyed Taylor Jenkins Reid’s “The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo,” and asked about “The Royal We” and its sequel “The Heir Affair.” The user subscribed to The New Yorker in early February 2023 and canceled Forbes in early March 2023 because its articles did not interest them enough.

Clothing and footwear: on 2023-12-06, the user said they had bought an H&M long-sleeved shirt for $15 during a winter clearance sale, discounted from $25; they also said they had been wearing new Adidas sneakers almost every day and owned a yellow skirt from a local boutique. On 2023-12-12, the user said they had recently bought high-waisted dark blue Levi’s jeans for about $80 and Adidas sneakers for $50, and was pleased with both purchases. The user aims to invest in timeless wardrobe pieces and planned to look for a quality denim jacket in the $100–$200 range, possibly from Levi’s.

Family relationships and support: the user said they and their sister had recently argued but were now in a good place; their parents have helped mediate conflicts among the siblings. The user’s mother is teaching them to make traditional Indian chicken curry, and the user enjoys experimenting with variations. The user calls grandparents who live far away every Sunday and reported having great conversations with them. The user said their brother is experiencing anxiety and depression and planned to ask their parents to arrange more frequent therapy, offering to help research therapists and counseling services.

Sustainable-fashion business exploration: on 2023-09-30, the user was considering an e-commerce business focused on sustainable fashion and decided to begin a business plan with market analysis. They explored researching market size, growth, trends, and consumer preferences, including using surveys or focus groups. The user then specified an interest in specializing in upcycled clothing and wanted to distinguish the brand; possible differentiators were brainstormed, but no specific positioning or business launch was confirmed. On 2023-12-13, the user separately asked about asset-based financing, lender research and negotiation, and business-plan resources, but the conversation does not establish that this financing exploration was for the same business.

Work planning for the week of 2023-12-04–2023-12-08: on 2023-11-30, the user said the marketing campaign was the top priority, a report was due Friday 2023-12-08, and website updates also needed attention; each project was estimated at 2–3 days. Their workday was 9 a.m.–5 p.m., lunch 12–1 p.m., with a Wednesday 2–3 p.m. meeting. The user favored a revised plan assigning Monday and Thursday to the campaign, Tuesday to report research, outlining, introduction and background, Wednesday to the report body, and Friday to conclusion, editing and finalization, leaving website updates flexible. The user said the plan was working in their favor and increased their confidence about submitting on time.

Yoga-effects research project: on 2023-12-07, the user described a Google Form with demographic and diet questions plus 13 five-point health and wellbeing items, covering areas such as sleep, mood, concentration, social anxiety, interest in activities, physical activity, and pain. The user was conducting a second data-collection round and wanted to compare it with the first, counting participants present in both and responses unique to each round. They assigned each response a user ID and wanted to match IDs in R; suggested operations included intersecting the two ID vectors and using set differences to identify round-specific IDs. The response-scale labels were not specified.

rollups.text: Instagram audience figures reported on 2023-12-01: the user estimated that a popular Yosemite hiking post received about 50 likes and 10 comments when the account had around 200 followers; the user said the account was gaining approximately 10 followers per week. These are reported estimates, not independently verified totals.

The user reported attending yoga twice a week in an undated account and later described attending three times a week in a work-scheduling discussion. The frequency therefore changed in the available records from twice weekly to three times weekly; dates for the earlier frequency are unspecified.
